name: Dear My Sun!! ~Musuko★Ikusei★Capriccio~
original_name: DEAR My SUN!!～ムスコ★育成★狂騒曲～
source:
You play as the mother of a pair of twins, whose father has left on an expedition to Egypt.

While raising the twins the mother can seek help with their careers from other characters, and maybe even choose to partner up with one them instead of waiting for her husband who has been missing for several years.
translation:
玩家将扮演一对双胞胎的母亲，孩子的父亲已经前往埃及探险。

在养育双胞胎的过程中，母亲可以向其他角色寻求有关孩子未来职业的帮助；她甚至可能不再等待那个失踪多年的丈夫，而是选择其中一人与自己相伴。
